row: Hi everyone! Dr. Anthony Moustakas here, I'm a chiropractor in Manhasset, New York, dedicated to helping people of all ages on their health and wellness journey. I focus on naturally reducing pain by addressing the neuro-musculoskeletal system through spinal adjustments, exercise, nutrition, and other holistic modalities. Enjoy the cracks and feel the difference!
